name: Sasame Hiyono
source:
Hiyono is shy and easily embarrassed. She respects [url=/c98611]Fumi[/url] and spends her day in search of a hot topic for the school newspaper. Ever since she found out about Fumi's fear of horror, she sometimes playfully teases her. Hiyono has a crush on [url=/c98385]Hayate[/url].

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
